physical.title: apron
physical.summary: A woman's apron.  Made from two equal sized pieces of dark blue wool cloth with patterning at the sides and lower half of the apron.  Sewn together along one of the selvedges to give a horizontal seam.  Tabby (weft faced) and tapestry woven.  Diamond and zigzag patterning at sides (woven as bands); worked in blue, green, maroon and black woollen yarns and gold- and silver- metal wrapped threads.  The same materials used to form bands towards the bottom of the apron.  Top of apron gathered onto black, blue and maroon flat braided trim, which is applied to all four sides.  Black wool loop at top corners to which is knotted a flat black wool (interlaced) tie.

physical.summary: A pair of woman's socks; hand knitted (stocking stitch) with black and some blue wool from hand spun yarn.  Solid black toe.  Blue bands on black 'ground' on foot and leg. physical.title: bib; plastron
physical.summary: A woman's bib / plastron; part of festive attire.  Made from a rectangular piece of natural cream twill woven cloth gathered onto a blue cotton velvet neckband.  Decoration in a 'V' shape at the middle top of plastron: small transparent, blue, green and red glass beads, gold and black faceted beads, a line of silver-coloured metal sequins, blue and black rickrack and polychrome tubular glass beads.  The neckband is similarly decorated and is fastened with a blue domed plastic button and green cotton braided loop.

physical.title: coat; jacket
physical.summary: A woman's coat, festive wear; sleeveless, waisted at the back.  Ground fabric made from black twill woven wool cloth; heavily fulled.  Two panels either side of centre front opening; fourteen panels at back, creating a very flared and heavy garment.  Elaborate couched wool braiding at square-shaped neckline; predominantly maroon, with blue, green, orange and black woollen yarns and yellow, green and blue cotton (?) threads.  Red and black chequered woollen cloth used as neckline facing.  Further predominatly maroon wool braiding (also blue, black and orange) stitched to lower centre front, and hemline.   Pocket in right side (as worn) with vertical opening also piped with braiding.

physical.title: waistcoat; coat
physical.summary: A woman's waistcoat / sleeveless coat, part of festive attire.  Made of dark red heavily fulled woven wool cloth; hand stitched.  Falls just below the knee.  Made of twenty-two separate panels, producing a very flared garment.  A deep, U-shaped neckline, decorated with extensive black, blue, and red wool braiding, with smaller areas of polychrome couched embroidery.  Further black braiding applied to armholes, hemline and openings to side pockets.  Yellow and green silk threads added to braiding as highlight. On upper back, above pleated 'skirt', is an inscription giving the name of the maker (?) 'TAHA' and the date '1947', embroidered in black wool thread.  Very heavy garment; some wear.

physical.title: shoe
physical.summary:
Pair (?) of woman's shoes (opanci), part of festive costume, summer wear; sewn and plaited dark and mid-brown, tan and light red/brown leather with metal buckle. Mid-brown base with extra piece for heel, base and toe all one piece sewn up centre of toe, black leather straps across front, deep red strap threaded through suede rim round heel and fastened with buckle.
     These shoes appear to be two right feet as the buckle is on the right hand side on both of them. On the base of (a) is the number 37 in blue pencil and on the base of (b) the number '36', suggesting that they are also two different sizes.

physical.title: apron
physical.summary: A woman's pleated apron, part of festive attire.  Made from two equal sized pieces of tapestry woven wool cloth, predominantly dark red, sewn together, horizontally, along one selvedge.  The centre field has isolated, elongated diamond motifs.  The deep border comprises linked zigzag patterning.  Similar patterning has been used along each side, with the addition of vertical lines with dashes.  All worked in dark red, green, blue and black woollen yarn and gold- and silver-metal wrapped-thread.  All four sides have applied black and green commercial wool braiding.  A braided tie is stitched to one top corner, a loop to the other.
